title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Definitions: Rental Days, Returns and Covered Days Used
content:
**Rental day.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, rental days are counted in periods of the class rental-day length, in hours, from the pickup time: the rental lasts from the pickup date and pickup time to the return date and return time, and at least the class's fewest rental days billed is billed.

**Key-drop return.** A key-drop return outside branch hours counts as returned at the branch's next opening time where the class counts after-hours returns at opening.

**Covered days used.** Covered days used are drawn once, at settlement.

**Mileage.** Mileage is unlimited where the class has unlimited mileage.

## Clauses no longer in force

- The clause under which a return no more than the class return grace in minutes into a new period does not start it is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.
- The clause under which covered days used are the rental days that start on or before the coverage end date, up to the covered days remaining, is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis of Rental Vehicle Coordination.

## Worked periods (hypothetical times, rental day of 24 hours)

| Pickup | Return | Periods begun | Rental days |
|---|---|---|---|
| Monday 10:00 | Wednesday 09:00 | Two (Monday 10:00 to Tuesday 10:00; Tuesday 10:00 to Wednesday 10:00) | 2 |
| Monday 10:00 | Wednesday 11:00 | Three (the third begins Wednesday 10:00) | 3 |
| Monday 10:00 | Monday 15:00 | One | 1, the fewest billed |

## Key-drop return (hypothetical)

A key-drop return on a Thursday at 22:00, outside branch hours, counts as returned on the Friday at the branch's opening time, the class counting after-hours returns at opening.

superseded_clauses: a return no more than return_grace_minutes minutes into a new period does not start it
Covered days used are the rental days that start on or before the coverage end date, up to the covered days remaining (rental_msr_covered_days_remaining)
